DEU.certainty_note: Unchanged grade: no official 2026 outflow figure exists yet. The decisive document is the government's answer to Kleine Anfrage 21/8052 (filed 18 Sep 2026), whose question 2 asks for Ist-Ausgaben 2022-2025 and 2026 to 30 June 2026 for Einzelplan 60, Kapitel 6002, Titel 687 06 and 687 03; it was not yet published on 23 Oct 2026. With it, 2026 can become B.

appropriation_2026_eur_bn.what: Einzelplan 60, Ertüchtigung (Titel 687 06, attacked states), final 2026 budget: raised by EUR 3bn from the EUR 8.5bn cabinet draft

appropriation_2025_eur_bn.plus: up to about EUR 2.5bn approved overspend (Haushaltsausschuss, March 2025, as reported in the BMF advisory council report; not verified from the primary record)

disbursed_2022_2025_eur_bn.what: budget outflows per Kiel Policy Brief 10/2026 (from government totals)

government_military_total_30jun2026_eur_.what: Bundesregierung list, Stand 30.06.2026: 'geleistet bzw. für die kommenden Jahre bereitgestellt', including commitments for later years, the value of Bundeswehr stock deliveries and training costs; the earlier list format (Stand 31.03.2025) counted only cash outflows (BMVg EUR 15.07bn)

DEU.arithmetic_2026: Expected Jan-Aug 2026 outflow = 11.55 x execution 0.80-1.00 x 8/12 = EUR 6.2-7.7bn. Kiel R31 records EUR 5.45bn of German aid for Jan-Aug 2026 (all types; military about 4.9-5.2). Gap = 1.0-2.8; central 1.4 (execution 0.9, military 5.0). Low 0: German money also flows as multi-year prepayments that Kiel books at contract or delivery, and part of 2026 appropriations pays for items Kiel dated in 2025. High 3.5: full execution and Kiel missing all non-itemised 2026 deliveries.
DEU.change_vs_current: 2026 central 1.5 -> 1.4, high 4.0 -> 3.5; 2022-2025 unchanged. Effect on the map: -0.1bn central (Germany toward Ukraine falls by EUR 0.1bn, about 0.002% of GDP).
